items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Willy DeParis, (Willy Martin) some people I didn't know.

ctx.x: People were calling me. I said, Look, man, I don't know. Now, here comes an idea. So the music, we did the music he got but he's a very fine musician. Billy Taylor was the pianist Lammor and Wilbur DeParis, (Willy Martin) some people I didn't know. And there came a time where the Negroes after intermission and the white people didn't get together.
